title: bsfa: Bayesian Stochastic Frontier Analysis
description:
An R package providing Bayesian inference for stochastic frontier models by Markov chain Monte Carlo.

Gibbs samplers with data augmentation are provided for composed-error frontier models in the tradition of van den Broeck, Koop, Osiewalski and Steel (1994), covering exponential and half-normal inefficiency, production and cost frontiers, and cross-sectional, time-invariant panel and four-component panel specifications. A model is built up step by step, by creating a model object and then adding priors, initial values and a seed to it before the posterior is drawn.

Because the one-sided inefficiency term is sampled as a latent variable rather than integrated out, posterior distributions of unit-specific efficiency scores are obtained directly from the augmented draws rather than from point predictors such as the Jondrow et al. (1982) conditional mean.
